memory_after.harborpass/customer-facing-retention-pol: HarborPass current customer-facing retention policy (permanent, established by issue trial-6ui on 2026-09-07, superseding release 1.0): every notice and export request, regardless of renewal date, sends notices 14 calendar days before renewal_on; members with completed_years >= 3 earn credit = floor(15% of plan_cents) capped at 3600 cents; members below 3 completed years get credit 0; autopay does not affect eligibility; amount_due_cents = plan_cents - credit_cents.
